text.arabic_uthmani: فَقَضَىٰهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَاتٍۢ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَأَوْحَىٰ فِى كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ أَمْرَهَا ۚ وَزَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَحِفْظًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ

words.gloss_range: sequential/result conjunction that binds the ayah opening to the prior scene
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the ayah open as consequence. It carries the prior heaven-smoke dialogue of 41:11 into execution, so the first movement is not a detached cosmology but a linked result. The particle is fused to the completion verb, making connection the first thing heard before the sevenfold architecture appears.

topics.headline: opening consequence hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the seven-heaven completion starts as the next executed result of the prior heaven-smoke dialogue, not as a detached cosmological notice.
topics.reason: The prefixed conjunction is aligned as the clause-opening connector before {{ar:قَضَىٰهُنَّ}} ({{tr:qaḍāhunna}}), and attachment evidence links this clause to the previous discourse.

words.gloss_range: decisive completion of the prior heaven-material into a sevenfold result, with the object suffix retaining boundary memory
words.root_gloss_range: completion, decision, execution, and decree; locally focused on decisive completion with authoritative settlement

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the result complement naming the achieved sevenfold heaven architecture

words.prose: {{ar:قَضَىٰهُنَّ}} ({{tr:qaḍāhunna}}) presents the heaven-forming act as already decisively executed. Its suffix keeps the prior heaven material grammatically present, then {{ar:سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَاتٍۢ}} ({{tr:sabʿa samāwātin}}) discloses the achieved shape. The q-d-y field gives the completion an authoritative decree-quality, while the local result complement keeps that decree focused on configured architecture; echoes such as 2:117 illuminate the decree-command field without replacing the local sevenfold result.

topics.headline: completed authoritative execution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the heavens are presented as decisively settled and executed, not as an ongoing natural development.
topics.reason: The perfect Form I verb and q-d-y completion/decree field support a compact executive act in the local result construction.

topics.headline: object suffix becomes sevenfold result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the prior heaven material carried inside the suffix before the result is revealed as seven heavens.
topics.reason: The attached feminine plural object and the following result complement account for the transition from antecedent domain to achieved architecture.

topics.headline: completion pairs with command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that completion and command form a recurring decree-field; the local act configures architecture rather than only issuing a speech-command as in 2:117.
topics.reason: The row supplies a concrete echo to 2:117, but local grammar keeps the result as sevenfold architecture.

words.gloss_range: accusative cardinal fixing the result as seven, with fullness carried through exact count
words.root_gloss_range: seven as exact enumeration with possible fullness resonance; local syntax keeps count primary

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later distributive totality that turns the sevenfold count into each-member coverage

words.prose: {{ar:سَبْعَ}} ({{tr:sabʿa}}) gives the completion its exact count. The number lands before the counted heavens, so measurement is heard before cosmic scale. Any fullness resonance is carried through precise enumeration, and the later {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) turns that total into exhaustive per-heaven administration; the familiar seven-heavens formula (2:29) is therefore not left as a bare cosmological label.

topics.headline: seven as result count
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that fullness comes through an exact accusative count before the cosmic domain is named.
topics.reason: The numeral is the accusative counted specification after the completion verb, so exact enumeration is grammatically primary.

topics.headline: sevenfold total becomes administered coverage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the familiar seven-heavens formula (2:29) is immediately prepared for per-heaven distribution rather than left as a bare count.
topics.reason: The count anticipates {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}), which turns the total into exhaustive command coverage.

words.gloss_range: genitive plural counted noun naming the elevated domains produced by completion
words.root_gloss_range: elevation and upper-domain sense; local use selects elevated heavenly domains, not mere naming or marking
words.prose: {{ar:سَمَٰوَاتٍۢ}} ({{tr:samāwātin}}) names the counted elevated domains produced by the completion, without forcing one physical model. The plural turns the previously addressed heaven of 41:11 into completed sevenfold architecture. The s-m-w elevation field is active here, while alternative marking/name pressures are only a boundary for interpretation; the ayah then keeps narrowing the same sky-root from total heavens to each governed heaven and finally to the nearest visible heaven.

topics.headline: counted elevated domains
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the plural heavens are countable elevated domains; the root-dispute material sharpens elevation here without replacing it by a mere label sense.
topics.reason: The genitive counted noun is licensed by the numeral construction; alternative marking/name pressures are not selected by the local form.

topics.headline: single smoke scene becomes plural architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary movement from the singular addressed heaven in 41:11 into a completed sevenfold plurality in 41:12.
topics.reason: The same sky-root crosses the verse boundary, while the plural morphology marks expansion.

topics.headline: plural scope begins a spatial descent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sky-root starts broad, then moves to each heaven and finally to the nearest visible heaven before closure gathers the whole again.
topics.reason: The repeated s-m-w terms in the ayah support a controlled movement from totality to individualization to visibility.

words.gloss_range: preposition setting the completion inside a bounded temporal or process frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the dual temporal complement governed by the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) places the completed sevenfold architecture inside a bounded process frame. Because the phrase comes after the result, the ayah lets the achieved heavens land before naming the duration or domain of completion. The preposition makes {{ar:يَوْمَيْنِ}} ({{tr:yawmayni}}) a temporal complement, not another object competing with the heavens.

topics.headline: completion placed inside a bounded frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the time phrase frames the completion process after the sevenfold result has landed, so duration does not compete with the object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:يَوْمَيْنِ}} ({{tr:yawmayni}}) the governed temporal complement of the completion verb.

words.gloss_range: dual genitive time phrase: exactly two bounded units, with cosmic scale left open
words.root_gloss_range: day, time, or event-period; local cosmic frame preserves elastic scale while dual morphology fixes two units

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the singular lexical base whose range includes day or event-period

words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمَيْنِ}} ({{tr:yawmayni}}) fixes the frame as exactly two units while leaving the cosmic scale open. The dual prevents vague timelessness, but Quranic usage such as 32:5 keeps {{ar:يَوْم}} ({{tr:yawm}}) available as event-period rather than ordinary earth-day only. Locally, the phrase scopes the completion clause most directly, while the surah later shifts the time horizon toward the Hour in 41:47.

topics.headline: two bounded units without terrestrial reduction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase fixes exactly two units while Quranic usage such as 32:5 keeps the scale from being reduced to ordinary earth-days.
topics.reason: Dual morphology and genitive government fix the count, while cosmic context and 32:5 support an event-period range.

topics.headline: time phrase scopes the completion clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the twofold time frame belongs most directly to the completion of the heavens, not automatically to every later clause.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase attaches to {{ar:قَضَىٰهُنَّ}} ({{tr:qaḍāhunna}}) before the coordinated command and adornment clauses.

topics.headline: creation time joins wider time horizon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the measured making-time participates in the surah-local time network, including the later Hour horizon in 41:47.
topics.reason: The supplied same-surah rows make the time root a local discourse thread without changing the immediate twofold grammar.

words.gloss_range: coordination that joins hidden command-assignment to completed architecture
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins hidden command-assignment to completed architecture. The conjunction adds a new finite act without detaching it from the same cosmic ordering movement. As soon as the heavens are completed, they are presented as governed domains.

topics.headline: architecture joined to administration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that completed heavens immediately become administered domains through a coordinated hidden-communication act.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces a coordinated finite clause after completion, preserving one cosmic ordering sequence.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect of hidden, effective communication assigning each heaven its command or affair
words.root_gloss_range: signaling, inspiration, revelation, and concealed instruction; local object and domain phrase narrow it to operative cosmic assignment

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the communicated command or affair assigned within each heaven
the fronted distributive domain phrase before the communicated object

words.prose: {{ar:أَوْحَىٰ}} ({{tr:awḥā}}) narrows hidden communication into effective cosmic assignment. The object {{ar:أَمْرَهَا}} ({{tr:amrahā}}) prevents the verb from sounding like vague inspiration; each heaven receives operative content. The {{ar:فِى كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ}} ({{tr:fī kulli samāʾin}}) frame lodges that assignment inside each domain, and parallels such as 16:68 and 41:6 show the root scaling from guidance and revelation into celestial administration.

topics.headline: hidden communication becomes cosmic assignment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hidden communication is not vague inspiration here; it effectively assigns each heaven its operative affair.
topics.reason: The Form IV perfect verb takes {{ar:أَمْرَهَا}} ({{tr:amrahā}}) as content, narrowing the w-ḥ-y range to effective cosmic instruction.

topics.headline: communication lodged inside each domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the construction foregrounds interior domain-by-domain placement before the communicated content is named.
topics.reason: The local {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) frame precedes the object and differs in focus from an endpoint frame.

topics.headline: waḥy scales from guidance to heavens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a root used for creature guidance in 16:68 and prophetic revelation in 41:6 is extended here into celestial administration.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows supply concrete parallels while the local object keeps the sense anchored to heavenly command-assignment.

words.gloss_range: preposition making each heaven the internal domain of the communicated command
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes every heaven the internal locus of the communicated command. The prepositional phrase arrives before the object, so distribution becomes the listener’s frame before the content is named. Governance is embedded within each heaven rather than merely sent toward it.

topics.headline: each heaven as command-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that command is placed within each heaven as its governed sphere, not merely sent toward it as a message endpoint.
topics.reason: The preposition governs {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) and fronts the distributive domain before the object.

words.gloss_range: construct totality distributing governance to each individual heaven
words.root_gloss_range: totality and entirety; local construct with singular sky makes exhaustive member-by-member coverage

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the earlier total count converted into exhaustive distribution

words.prose: {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) breaks the sevenfold whole into exhaustive member-by-member coverage. In construct with a singular sky noun, it says every heaven individually has assigned governance, not merely that all heavens are collectively under order. This movement from {{ar:سَبْعَ}} ({{tr:sabʿa}}) to {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) prepares the closing claim of calibrated measure, and 65:12 provides a concrete parallel for command moving through layered cosmic order.

topics.headline: totality distributes one by one
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sevenfold whole is broken into each member, leaving no heaven without its assigned governance.
topics.reason: Construct totality with a singular governed noun gives member-by-member distributive force.

topics.headline: counted total becomes calibrated distribution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from exact sevenfold count to exhaustive distribution, preparing the final claim of measured determination.
topics.reason: The local sequence connects {{ar:سَبْعَ}} ({{tr:sabʿa}}), {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}), and {{ar:تَقْدِيرُ}} ({{tr:taqdīru}}) as stages of measured coverage.

topics.headline: layered command parallel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 65:12 also links divine command with layered cosmic order, while 41:12 locates each layer’s own command inside it.
topics.reason: The cross-reference is concrete and supports total command coverage without overriding the local construct grammar.

words.gloss_range: singular genitive under totality: each elevated layer as its own governed domain
words.root_gloss_range: elevated domain or sky; local distributive frame selects a bounded heaven-layer, not merely visible sky

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the construct totality under which the singular sky is individualized

words.prose: {{ar:سَمَآءٍ}} ({{tr:samāʾin}}) re-enters the plural heavens one layer at a time. Under {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}), the singular term becomes a bounded command-bearing domain rather than merely the visible sky. This middle sky-root occurrence prevents the later nearest heaven from absorbing the whole sevenfold order; it holds the hidden interior governance open, with 2:29 in the background as a seven-heaven creation parallel.

topics.headline: singular sky re-enters each layer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the plural heavens are re-entered one layer at a time, so each layer can carry its own command.
topics.reason: The singular genitive under {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) individualizes the prior plural.

topics.headline: sky as governed domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this occurrence is a bounded command-bearing layer, not simply the visible sky; 2:29 supplies a seven-heaven background but 41:12 opens the interior governance.
topics.reason: The following possessed command selects a governed-domain reading for the singular sky term.

topics.headline: middle sky term blocks visual reduction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah pauses at each-heaven governance before narrowing to the nearest visible heaven.
topics.reason: This second sky-root occurrence mediates between total architecture and the later lower-sky object.

words.gloss_range: possessed command, affair, or governance content assigned to each heaven
words.root_gloss_range: command, affair, matter, and governance; local hidden-communication frame selects directive assigned function while retaining the broader affair sense

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the distributive totality whose force is continued by the possessive suffix
the hidden-communication verb governing this command as its content

words.prose: {{ar:أَمْرَهَا}} ({{tr:amrahā}}) is the content assigned within each heaven. The suffix makes the command or affair belong to each individual domain, so distribution is not only stated by {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) but attached to the noun itself. The word keeps command, affair, and governance together, while the local {{ar:أَوْحَىٰ}} ({{tr:awḥā}}) frame narrows that range to communicated directive function; 36:82 shows a creative-command background, but 41:12 distributes operation inside completed heavens.

topics.headline: each heaven has its own affair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the suffix makes every heaven’s command its own, not a shared undifferentiated cosmic instruction.
topics.reason: The feminine suffix resumes the singular {{ar:سَمَآءٍ}} ({{tr:samāʾin}}) under {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}), performing the distribution morphologically.

topics.headline: directive content with affair range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the noun is the content conveyed by hidden communication: command, affair, and governance converge as assigned function.
topics.reason: As object of {{ar:أَوْحَىٰ}} ({{tr:awḥā}}), the word is not a vague topic; local syntax narrows it to communicated directive content.

topics.headline: completed structure receives operation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a shift from singular creative command in 36:82 to distributed governance within already completed heavens.
topics.reason: The qaḍā-amr pairing is locally supported: completion is followed by operational assignment.

words.gloss_range: coordination carrying the action chain into first-person plural adornment
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the action chain into a new visible stage. It coordinates the adornment clause with the earlier third-person verbs while allowing the shift into first-person plural divine speech. The result is continuity with heightened presence when the lower sky enters view.

topics.headline: coordination carries the speaker shift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the action chain continues while the discourse shifts into first-person plural precisely at the visible lower-sky stage.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the adornment clause with prior third-person clauses and licenses continuity through iltifāt.

words.gloss_range: Form II first-plural perfect: completed, produced adornment of the nearest heaven by lamps
words.root_gloss_range: beauty, ornament, and made-attractive appearance; local instrument phrase grounds it in visible luminous furnishing

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the instrument phrase naming lamps as the means of adornment

words.prose: {{ar:زَيَّنَّا}} ({{tr:zayyannā}}) makes adornment an enacted divine furnishing. The verb takes the nearest heaven as object and {{ar:بِمَصَٰبِيحَ}} ({{tr:bi-maṣābīḥa}}) as means, so beauty is concretely produced through lamps. Form II and the first-person plural voice intensify the visible display, while parallels such as 37:6 show the adorned-nearest-heaven formula; 41:12 adds lamps and protection, and 41:25 later shifts the same root into a different moral field.

topics.headline: adornment as enacted furnishing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that beauty is an enacted furnishing of the nearest heaven by lamps, not an abstract claim that the sky is attractive.
topics.reason: The transitive verb takes the nearest heaven as object and the lamp phrase as means.

topics.headline: Form II and first plural intensify agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a stronger produced-adornment force and a more immediate divine voice when the scene turns visible.
topics.reason: The geminated Form II first-plural perfect combines intensified causation with the discourse shift to direct divine plural.

topics.headline: adornment formula gains protection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that parallels such as 37:6 share the adorned-nearest-heaven formula, while 41:12 adds lamps and protection and later 41:25 shifts the root into a moralized adornment field.
topics.reason: The concrete references support formula and contrast without changing the local transitive adornment frame.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative sky as the specific object of adornment, restricted by the following adjective
words.root_gloss_range: elevated sky or heaven; local definiteness and adjective select the known nearest heaven, not all seven heavens

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the agreeing adjective that restricts the sky to the nearest or lower heaven

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَآءَ}} ({{tr:al-samāʾa}}) is the specific adorned object. Its definiteness, accusative role, and agreement with {{ar:ٱلدُّنْيَا}} ({{tr:al-dunyā}}) narrow the reference to the known nearest heaven, not the whole sevenfold set. The repeated sky-root now lands in human visibility after total architecture and hidden per-heaven command; 67:5 confirms that nearest-heaven lamps can also carry defensive function.

topics.headline: one known sky receives adornment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that adornment is assigned to a specific nearest heaven, not to the whole sevenfold order.
topics.reason: Definiteness, accusative object role, and adjective agreement select the known lower sky.

topics.headline: visible adornment also participates in defense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 67:5 closely parallels the nearest-heaven lamp image and links it to defense, matching the local move toward protection.
topics.reason: The cross-reference supports the local beauty-protection pairing while the local word remains the adorned object.

topics.headline: third sky-root lands in visibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the staged narrowing from total heavens to each hidden command-bearing heaven and finally to the human-visible lower layer.
topics.reason: This third s-m-w occurrence completes the local scale movement toward visibility.

words.gloss_range: definite feminine adjective qualifying the sky as nearest or lower
words.root_gloss_range: nearness, lowness, and worldly immediacy; local agreement with sky selects proximity within the heavenly hierarchy

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the sky noun modified by the nearest/lower adjective

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلدُّنْيَا}} ({{tr:al-dunyā}}) qualifies the sky as nearer or lower. The d-n-w range includes worldliness, but agreement with {{ar:ٱلسَّمَآءَ}} ({{tr:al-samāʾa}}) makes proximity the controlling sense here. After hidden command in every heaven, this adjective marks the accessible interface of the sevenfold order, the layer furnished with visible lamps; 67:5 confirms the same lower-heaven adornment formula.

topics.headline: nearness controls the adjective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the adjective ranks the heaven as nearer or lower; it does not introduce worldly life as an independent noun.
topics.reason: Agreement with {{ar:ٱلسَّمَآءَ}} ({{tr:al-samāʾa}}) makes proximity within the sky phrase the controlling sense.

topics.headline: nearest layer as visible interface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the layer humans can observe is distinguished from the hidden administration of every heaven and is the one furnished with visible lamps.
topics.reason: The nearness field pairs naturally with the lamp phrase and follows the hidden per-heaven command clause.

topics.headline: adorned lower-heaven formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 67:5 confirms this as the adorned lower-heaven formula, now embedded in 41:12 within the larger measured-order sequence.
topics.reason: The formulaic parallel supports the nearest-heaven reading without replacing the local adjective agreement.

words.gloss_range: preposition making lamps the means and furnishing of adornment
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) turns the lamps into the means and furnishing of adornment. They are not a second direct object; they are the equipment by which the nearest heaven is made beautiful. The prepositional phrase supplies the concrete instrument that completes the adornment frame.

topics.headline: lamps as means and furnishing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lamps are the means and attached equipment of adornment, not a second object being beautified.
topics.reason: The preposition governs {{ar:مَصَٰبِيحَ}} ({{tr:maṣābīḥa}}) after {{ar:زَيَّنَّا}} ({{tr:zayyannā}}), supplying the concrete instrument phrase.

words.gloss_range: bi-governed broken plural of lamp-instruments that furnish the lower sky
words.root_gloss_range: morning, brightness, and lamp-instrument imagery; local plural selects concrete luminous instruments

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the following protection noun that turns lamp-adornment toward guarded function

words.prose: {{ar:مَصَٰبِيحَ}} ({{tr:maṣābīḥa}}) gives the adornment concrete light-instruments. The broken plural spreads lamp imagery across the lower sky, and the ṣ-b-ḥ brightness field makes them instruments of disclosure rather than inert decoration. In contrast to the singular lamp image of 24:35, 41:12 distributes lamps as cosmic equipment, then immediately links them with {{ar:حِفْظًۭا}} ({{tr:ḥifẓan}}), so visible beauty also serves guarded order.

topics.headline: plural light instruments furnish the sky
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices many concrete lamp-instruments spread across the lower sky, resisting a purely abstract reading of adornment.
topics.reason: The bi-governed broken plural marks the lamps as instruments of adornment and multiplies the light-source image.

topics.headline: dawn-root makes light disclose
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lamp word draws on brightness and disclosure; 24:35 uses a singular lamp image, while 41:12 distributes lamp-instruments across the sky.
topics.reason: The ṣ-b-ḥ field and the 24:35 contrast support luminous instrumentality without abstracting away from the plural form.

topics.headline: visible beauty joins guarding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lower-sky lights are immediately linked to guarding and measured order, so beauty becomes functional cosmic equipment.
topics.reason: The lamp phrase is followed by {{ar:وَحِفْظًۭا}} ({{tr:wa-ḥifẓan}}), tying adornment to protection in the same clause.

words.gloss_range: coordination attaching protection to the adornment clause without a new finite verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the accusative verbal noun coordinated by this conjunction

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps protection inside the same lower-sky outfitting. It coordinates {{ar:حِفْظًۭا}} ({{tr:ḥifẓan}}) without starting a new finite action, so guarding remains attached to the lamp-adornment frame. Beauty and protection are heard together rather than as separate themes.

topics.headline: guarding kept inside the adornment clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that protection is coordinated into the same lower-sky outfitting, not detached as a separate later topic.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the accusative verbal noun after the lamp phrase without introducing another finite verb.

words.gloss_range: accusative verbal noun compressing protection, preservation, or guarding as a function of the adorned heaven
words.root_gloss_range: guarding, preserving, keeping intact, and retaining; local accusative makes protection a standing design-function

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the closing measured-determination noun anticipated by protection

words.prose: {{ar:حِفْظًۭا}} ({{tr:ḥifẓan}}) compresses guarding into an accusative standing function. The verbal noun can mark purpose, result, or function, making protection part of the adorned heaven’s design rather than a later event. Its root covers defense and preservation, with guarded-heaven passages such as 15:17 and 21:32 supporting the cosmic protection reading; it also anticipates {{ar:تَقْدِيرُ}} ({{tr:taqdīru}}), because measured order must be maintained after it is set.

topics.headline: maṣdar compresses guarding into function
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guarding is compressed into an accusative standing function of the adorned heaven rather than narrated as a separate finite event.
topics.reason: The accusative verbal noun can mark purpose, result, or function and remains syntactically attached to the adornment clause.

topics.headline: protection means defense and preservation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word covers defense and preservation, with guarded-heaven passages such as 15:17 and 21:32 supporting a cosmic protection reading.
topics.reason: The root range and concrete guarding parallels fit the local lower-heaven lamp context.

topics.headline: guarding preserves measured order
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that protection anticipates the final measured determination: order is not only made but maintained against disorder.
topics.reason: The row links {{ar:حِفْظًۭا}} ({{tr:ḥifẓan}}) forward to {{ar:تَقْدِيرُ}} ({{tr:taqdīru}}) as preservation of calibration.

words.gloss_range: demonstrative subject packaging the whole preceding arrangement for evaluation
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) gathers the whole sequence into one subject. Completion, per-heaven command, lower-sky adornment, and protection are packaged for reflection before the predicate names their shared logic. The distal demonstrative creates evaluative distance: the listener is made to re-see the separate acts as one ordered arrangement.

topics.headline: whole sequence becomes one subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices completion, distribution, adornment, and protection being gathered into one object of reflection before the predicate names it as measured determination.
topics.reason: The demonstrative functions as the subject of the closing nominal clause and packages all prior clauses for evaluation.

words.gloss_range: Form II verbal noun predicating the whole sequence as measured determination
words.root_gloss_range: measuring, apportioning, determining, and capacity; local closure names calibrated divine ordering

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the opening completion verb whose execution arc closes as calibrated measure

words.prose: {{ar:تَقْدِيرُ}} ({{tr:taqdīru}}) names what the packaged sequence is: measured determination. The Form II verbal noun turns the two periods, seven heavens, each command, lamps, and guarding into one calibrated act, not a list of wonders. It closes the arc opened by {{ar:قَضَىٰهُنَّ}} ({{tr:qaḍāhunna}}): execution becomes proportioned order, while 36:38 shows the same formula applied to the sun’s course and 41:10 and 41:39 reinforce the surah’s measure thread.

topics.headline: closure names calibrated measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior event-chain is reclassified as calibrated apportionment and deliberate design, not a mere list of marvels.
topics.reason: The Form II verbal noun predicates the demonstrative package and intensifies the measure/apportionment field.

topics.headline: measure framed by might and knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same measured-order formula used for the sun’s course in 36:38 is extended here to seven-heaven architecture and administration.
topics.reason: The concrete formula recurrence supports the closing attribution without making the local phrase depend on 36:38.

topics.headline: execution closes as calibrated order
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that decisive completion at the opening and measured calibration at the close form one ayah-level arc, with 41:10 and 41:39 reinforcing the surah-local measure thread.
topics.reason: The local sequence begins with q-d-y execution and closes with q-d-r calibration.

words.gloss_range: genitive divine title attributing measured order to unopposed might
words.root_gloss_range: might, dominance, inaccessibility, and resistance to defeat; local title grounds protection and measure in invincible agency

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the construct head governing the mighty title
the preceding protection noun grounded by the title of might

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَزِيزِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿazīzi}}) attributes the measured order to unopposed might. As a genitive title after {{ar:تَقْدِيرُ}} ({{tr:taqdīru}}), it prevents the cosmic order from sounding impersonal. Coming after {{ar:حِفْظًۭا}} ({{tr:ḥifẓan}}), the title grounds protection in invincible sovereignty, a guarded order no rival can breach or revise; the paired formula also appears in 36:38, and here power is heard before knowledge.

topics.headline: measured order has invincible source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that measured order is attributed to a named divine title, not to impersonal cosmic law.
topics.reason: The title is genitive after {{ar:تَقْدِيرُ}} ({{tr:taqdīru}}), forming the source attribution.

topics.headline: guarded cosmos grounded in might
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that protection rests on unopposed sovereignty; the guarded lower heaven is not a fragile technical defense.
topics.reason: The ʿ-z-z field of dominance and resistance fits the preceding protection noun and the closing title.

topics.headline: power precedes knowledge in the seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the paired title recurs in celestial-measure contexts such as 36:38, and here power is heard before knowledge.
topics.reason: The title order frames measure first as unopposed efficacy and then as informed precision.

words.gloss_range: second genitive divine title completing attribution with comprehensive knowledge
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge and full knowing; local final title makes hidden assignment and visible measure rest on complete knowledge

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the first genitive title sharing the attribution frame with the final title
the hidden-communication verb whose unseen assignment is closed by knowledge
the assigned command or affair known behind each heaven

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَلِيمِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿalīmi}}) completes the attribution with comprehensive knowledge. The title shares the genitive frame with {{ar:ٱلْعَزِيزِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿazīzi}}), so measured order rests on knowing power, not force alone. The audience may see lamps, but the final word names knowledge behind every hidden {{ar:أَوْحَىٰ}} ({{tr:awḥā}}) and {{ar:أَمْرَهَا}} ({{tr:amrahā}}); 2:29 likewise closes seven-heaven creation with knowledge, and the title pair belongs to broader cosmic-measure formulas.

topics.headline: knowledge completes measured power
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that measured cosmic order rests on comprehensive knowledge as well as might.
topics.reason: The second genitive title completes the same construct attribution after {{ar:ٱلْعَزِيزِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿazīzi}}).

topics.headline: seven-heaven creation closes with knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 2:29 also connects seven-heaven creation with comprehensive knowledge, while 41:12 names the knowing title at the end.
topics.reason: The concrete parallel supports the title’s closing fit without changing the local genitive apposition.

topics.headline: final word makes hidden order known
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the audience may see lamps, but the ayah ends by naming the knowledge behind every hidden assignment.
topics.reason: The final title gathers hidden {{ar:أَوْحَىٰ}} ({{tr:awḥā}}), {{ar:أَمْرَهَا}} ({{tr:amrahā}}), visible lamps, and guarded measure into complete knowledge.

topics.headline: paired title recurs in cosmic measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the title pair belongs to a broader cosmic-measure formula, not an arbitrary ending.
topics.reason: The row explicitly links the paired title to recurring cosmic-measure contexts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَقَضَىٰهُنَّ ... وَأَوْحَىٰ فِى كُلِّ سَمَاءٍ أَمْرَهَا
baseline_models.mechanism: Effective, completed making is followed by hidden delivery of an obligatory charge to every layer; the seven heavens are therefore finished as individually commissioned units, not merely accumulated matter.

activation_trace.role: Well-wrought making and effective execution supply the constitutive completion of the seven units.
Hidden delivery of knowledge supplies the transmission that commissions each finished unit.
Comprehensive inclusion makes the distribution exhaustive across the layers.
Binding request or command supplies the operative charge assigned within each heaven.
Deliberative preparation and exact arrangement frame the commissions as one designed system.

changed_reading.before: Seven heavens were made and each was informed of its affair.
changed_reading.after: Seven differentiated operational units were brought to effective completion and each was privately commissioned with its own charge.

baseline_models.mechanism: The nearest overlying canopy is made visibly luminous and simultaneously guarded; display and defense form a coupled boundary function.

activation_trace.role: What rises and overshadows supplies the canopy-like spatial layer.
Nearness places this layer at the proximal interface of the ordered heavens.
Lamps and celestial luminaries supply the visible signaling surface.
Making beauty manifest turns luminosity into deliberate public display.
Watchful guarding gives the same visible layer a defensive perimeter function.

changed_reading.before: The lowest heaven was decorated with lamps and also protected.
changed_reading.after: The nearest canopy is a luminous guarded threshold whose visibility and perimeter control belong to one design.

baseline_models.mechanism: Number, duration, completion, and measured limit converge: plurality is counted, formation is temporally bounded, and the result is declared calibrated.

activation_trace.role: Finishing and bringing to term close the formation process.
The explicit number supplies discrete structural count.
A duration of time supplies a bounded production interval without requiring an ordinary daylight day.
A quantity reaching its proper limit makes count and duration jointly calibrating.
Complete cognition grounds the precision of the calibration.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a number of heavens and a creation duration.
changed_reading.after: Count and duration are mutually constraining specifications in a knowingly bounded act of completion.

baseline_models.mechanism: A non-dominant mapped inventory lets the repeated heaven root activate visible marking and diagnostic signs; lamps then function as legible marks on elevated layers, while knowledge names their intelligibility.

activation_trace.role: A visible mark by which something is known supplies a secondary semiotic image for the repeated heavens.
A sign from which a condition is inferred makes the marked surface evidentiary rather than merely decorative.
Celestial lamps provide the actual visible marks carried by the nearest layer.
A distinguishing sign that guides supplies the link from visible marking to knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are elevated locations, one of which bears lights.
changed_reading.after: The elevated layers can also be carried as legible marked surfaces, with the nearest layer's lights acting as diagnostic signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening presents revelation as a delivered book whose signs are differentiated in detail, then repeats revelation to the messenger. Against that sequence, completing seven heavens and communicating each one's affair becomes a cosmic analogue of articulation: a whole is divided into addressable units and each unit receives determinate content.

activation_trace.role: Decisive conveyance gives the focus completion a communicative edge alongside its constitutive force.
Writing or inscription supplies an articulated-record image for the charge placed in each layer.
Each heaven's own affair supplies the differentiated content of the cosmic articulation.
Caused descent and delivery supply the surah's initial transmission frame.
A fixed writing that obliges judgment or measure links textual inscription to effective cosmic ordinance.
Detailing that exposes parts and meanings supplies the division of one whole into distinct intelligible units.
A manifest sign makes each differentiated unit capable of bearing disclosed meaning.
Divine revelation to the messenger supplies the explicit human-side counterpart to revelation within every heaven.

structural_cues: The surah opens with descent, book, detailed signs, and knowing readers in that order.
The same و ح ي form occurs at 41:6 for revelation to the human messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two revelation scenes and a book detailed into signs; I supply the analogy that the sevenfold completion is a cosmic articulation into commissioned units. A live alternative is that the focus revelation is only a decree with no textual analogy.

changed_reading.before: Each completed heaven receives an operational command.
changed_reading.after: Creation itself is articulated like a differentiated communiqué: the sevenfold whole is partitioned into addressable units and each unit receives its determinate content.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate creation sequence measures earth's sustenance for askers, stabilizes it, and elicits willing response from smoke-like heaven and earth. The focus commands can therefore be read as the layer-specific operating assignments of one obedient provisioning and preservation network.

activation_trace.role: Effective construction turns the responsive material of the prior verse into finished functional layers.
An obligatory charge supplies the operating instruction for each layer.
Prepared and calculated arrangement integrates the layer assignments with terrestrial provisioning.
Guarding supplies the preservation function within the larger service network.
Estimating and measuring a thing makes terrestrial creation part of the same calibrated process.
Measured preparation of sustenance supplies the concrete provisioning task to which cosmic assignments can contribute.
Standing over something in preservation, power, and witness unites sustenance with the focus roles of guarding and knowing.
Equality between recipients supplies the distributive constraint on measured provision.
Rising smoke supplies the unfinished material state transformed by the focus completion.
Willing obedience supplies the response mode by which heaven and earth enter their assigned functions.

structural_cues: Earth is created in two days, its sustenance is measured in four, and the heavens are completed in two.
Heaven and earth are directly addressed at 41:11 and jointly answer that they come willingly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured sustenance, equal access, responsive material, and willing obedience; I infer that each heaven's charge operationalizes this coordinated provisioning order. The live alternative is that the charges are decrees unrelated to sustenance.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are completed according to a precise plan.
changed_reading.after: The heavens become an obedient, calibrated service network whose layer-specific charges support provision, stability, and preservation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later, bodily materials testify and God makes every thing speak. This activates the possibility that heavens receiving their own affairs are not inert containers but commissioned, responsive bearers capable of disclosing the order placed in them.

activation_trace.role: Hiddenly imparted knowledge supplies content that a commissioned layer can later manifest.
Exhaustive inclusion extends responsive capacity to every heaven.
Each layer's own affair supplies the particular content it bears and performs.
Knowledge disclosed to a knower frames the cosmic order as intelligible and revealable.
Testimony that states something from knowledge supplies the evidentiary action of created material.
Being made to speak supplies explicit responsiveness rather than inert containment.
The statement that every thing can be made articulate broadens the possible agency of each heaven.
Unconcealed divine knowledge supplies the ground on which material testimony is reliable.

structural_cues: Hearing, sight, and skins testify at 41:20.
At 41:21 the creator of all things is said to make them speak.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speaking and testifying created materials; I extend that created responsiveness to the heavens because each is explicitly addressed with its own affair. The live alternative is that speech here is exceptional to judgment and says nothing about cosmic function.

changed_reading.before: Each heaven is an operational unit carrying an assigned function.
changed_reading.after: Each heaven can also be carried as a responsive bearer of knowledge, commissioned to perform and potentially disclose its assigned order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later shows adornment used to beautify a false field of perception, while sun and moon are visible signs that must not become objects of worship. The focus coupling of adornment with guarding therefore reads as regulated sign-display: beauty reveals order but is kept from becoming its own authority.

activation_trace.role: Making beauty manifest supplies the luminous display whose epistemic use is at issue.
Celestial lamps provide concrete visible objects that can direct attention.
Guarding constrains and preserves the display rather than leaving beauty epistemically unregulated.
Manifest beautification here distorts perception, supplying the negative contrast that makes guarded adornment significant.
A manifest sign defines the celestial lights as evidence pointing beyond themselves.
The sun supplies one visible celestial sign explicitly denied independent worship.
The moon and its heavenly light supply the second visible sign denied independent worship.

structural_cues: At 41:25 companions beautify what lies before and behind people, and the result is loss.
At 41:37 night, day, sun, and moon are signs, but worship is redirected to their creator.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deceptive adornment and non-worshiped celestial signs; I infer that the focus adjacency of adornment and guarding marks a disciplined display that preserves correct reference. A live alternative is that guarding is purely spatial and unrelated to perception.

changed_reading.before: The nearest heaven is aesthetically lit and physically defended.
changed_reading.after: Its lights form a guarded sign-display: their beauty discloses order while being denied the status of autonomous authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later book is called mighty and inaccessible to falsehood from either direction, then identified as a descent. Because the focus also joins hidden communication, guarding, and the Mighty, its nearest heaven can be read as preserving the integrity of transmitted order as well as defending space.

activation_trace.role: Writing and inscription supply the transmitted content whose integrity can be preserved.
Guarding supplies active preservation at the nearest cosmic boundary.
Might and impregnability ground the resistance of the ordered medium.
Ordered written content supplies the later medium explicitly described as mighty.
Might and inviolability characterize the book and activate the same quality in the focus design.
Loss of truth and stability names the contaminant that cannot enter the protected book.
Delivered descent links the inviolable book back to the focus's hidden communication.

structural_cues: The book is called عزيز at 41:41, repeating the focus epithet.
At 41:42 falsehood cannot approach it from before or behind.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a protected, mighty transmission and a guarded cosmic layer under the Mighty; I infer a shared integrity mechanism between revelation and cosmic communication. The live alternative is that the repeated epithet marks only divine power and does not connect the two media.

changed_reading.before: Guarding protects the nearest heaven as a spatial perimeter.
changed_reading.after: Guarding also protects the integrity of a communicated order, making the nearest heaven an inviolable transmission medium parallel to the mighty book.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later use of ق ض ي for judgment between disputants activates the focus root's decisive legal branch. Joined to sevenfold division and each heaven's own authority-bearing affair, completion can be read as constituting distinct jurisdictions.

activation_trace.role: A decisive ruling supplies the constitutive act that partitions and settles the sevenfold order.
Exhaustive inclusion ensures that no heaven lies outside the constituted distribution.
Authority and delegated rule make each heaven's own affair resemble a jurisdictional competence.
Judgment between parties supplies the explicit adjudicative use that reactivates the legal force of the focus verb.
Separation and distinction supply the boundary-making effect of adjudication.

structural_cues: At 41:45 judgment between disputants is deferred because of a prior word.
The focus distributes an affair to each member of a sevenfold whole.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit later adjudicative use of the same verb; I project that constitutive force onto the focus and treat each assigned affair as a jurisdiction. The live alternative is the dominant manufacturing sense, with no legal partition intended.

changed_reading.before: Seven crafted layers each receive a function.
changed_reading.after: A decisive constitutive act establishes seven jurisdictions, each invested with its own sphere of charge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine knowledge later spans the hour, fruit emerging from coverings, hidden gestation, and birth. This turns focus تقدير from macroscopic count and schedule into fine-grained coordination of thresholds where concealed processes become manifest.

activation_trace.role: Temporal duration supplies the large-scale schedule that context will refine into event-level timing.
A thing reaching its measured limit supplies calibration at every scale.
Complete cognition grounds exact knowledge of hidden and manifest stages.
Knowledge encompassing both final time and reproductive detail supplies the context's scale-bridging precision.
Passage to the outside supplies the hidden-to-manifest threshold.
Ripened fruit supplies an outcome that appears only when its process reaches measure.
The plant's enclosing sheath supplies the concealed stage from which measured emergence occurs.
An inward load or fruit supplies the hidden developmental process.
Delivery in birth supplies the timed transition from carrying to manifest release.

structural_cues: At 41:47 knowledge of the hour is placed beside fruit emergence, pregnancy, and birth.
The focus closes its counted and timed construction with the epithet العليم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive knowledge of temporal and generative transitions; I infer that focus تقدير coordinates such thresholds rather than only fixing gross dimensions. A live alternative is that the closing phrase emphasizes sovereignty without specifying process-level timing.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are produced to a measured count and duration.
changed_reading.after: The same estimation reaches into event-level timing, coordinating when concealed processes in the ordered world cross into manifestation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing promise places signs in distant horizons and in selves until truth becomes manifest, then invokes witness over every thing. The focus lamps on the nearest heaven become the outward edge of a paired evidentiary field rather than isolated ornaments.

activation_trace.role: A visible distinguishing mark supplies the semiotic potential of the repeated heaven term.
Celestial lamps supply the observable marks at the outward horizon.
A mark that distinguishes and guides links cosmic visibility to cognition.
Manifest signs explicitly define what is shown in horizons and selves.
Distant regions and horizons locate the external field that includes the visible heavens.
The thing itself or its own self supplies the inward counterpart to horizon evidence.
Coming into view supplies the evidentiary result of the paired sign fields.
Testimony from knowledge makes the visible marks participate in a comprehensive witness structure.

structural_cues: At 41:53 signs are shown in horizons and selves until truth becomes clear.
The verse closes by invoking witness over every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward and inward signs that yield clarity; I identify the focus's celestial lamps as one outward sign-set because they occupy the nearest visible heaven. A live alternative is that the horizon signs refer to other phenomena and do not reactivate the lamps specifically.

changed_reading.before: The nearest heaven bears legible luminous marks.
changed_reading.after: Those lights participate in an outward evidentiary field paired with signs in selves, moving the focus from ornament to horizon-level disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final declaration of enclosure around every thing resolves through branches of ح و ط that combine preservation with complete enclosure in knowledge and secure possession. The focus's local guard and per-heaven distribution are thus nested expressions of total custody.

activation_trace.role: Overlying canopies supply the nested spatial layers held within the larger enclosure.
Exhaustive inclusion distributes the order through every heaven.
Guarding supplies the local preservation function at the nearest layer.
Complete knowledge supplies the cognitive dimension of custody.
Every thing extends the closing enclosure without remainder.
Preservation and protective custody directly reactivate the focus guard.
Complete enclosure in knowledge and secure possession unites the focus's guarding and knowing.

structural_cues: The focus says every heaven receives its affair and singles out guarding at the nearest layer.
The surah closes with God encompassing every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a closing root whose branches explicitly join preservation, knowledge, and enclosure; I treat the focus guard as a local manifestation of that total custody. The live alternative is that the closing enclosure is only omniscience, while focus guarding is a separate function.

changed_reading.before: Each heaven has a local assignment, and the nearest has a local guard.
changed_reading.after: The distributed assignments and nearest-layer guard are nested operations within comprehensive preserving and knowing custody.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it relies on the non-dominant و س م and س م م mappings of the repeated heaven root, especially mark, aperture, and sealing branches. It remains anchored in the three focus occurrences of heaven, the lamps, and explicit guarding, and the branches form a coherent boundary mechanism. Downstream prose should present it only as a branch-generated material analogy, not as the lexical meaning of سماء or as evidence for literal gates.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سَمَٰوَاتٍ ... سَمَآءٍ ... ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَحِفْظًا

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark lets the nearest heaven's lights act as boundary markers.
A narrow aperture through which something enters supplies a possible controlled-interface image.
Sealing and tightening supply closure and ingress control at that interface.
Celestial lamps supply visible markers on the proposed membrane.
Guarding supplies the membrane's selective protective function.
The inability of destabilizing falsehood to enter the later medium gives contextual support to controlled ingress.

changed_reading.before: The nearest heaven is a luminous guarded canopy.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it behaves like a marked, gated membrane whose luminous points identify a boundary while guarding regulates passage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a context branch for حمل moves directly from female gestation to a load in sky or cloud, inviting a cross-domain reading of celestial layers as carriers. It remains anchored in سماء, each layer's affair, تقدير, and العليم, with context supplying concealment and emergence. Downstream prose should call this a process analogy for carrying latent outcomes, never a claim that the heavens are biologically pregnant.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فِى كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ أَمْرَهَا ... تَقْدِيرُ ... ٱلْعَلِيمِ

activation_trace.role: Sky, cloud, and what rises overhead supply the carrier domain.
Each layer's own affair supplies the latent content or process it carries.
Reaching a measured limit supplies maturation and timed release.
Knowledge of the concealed process and its outcome supplies exact oversight.
An inward load or fruit supplies the gestational carrying image.
A load in sky or cloud explicitly transfers carrying into the celestial domain.
An enclosing plant sheath supplies protected latency before emergence.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the eventual manifestation of the carried process.

changed_reading.before: Each heaven statically contains an assigned affair.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, each layer carries a latent process or load toward a measured emergence under complete knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the morning branch of مصابيح with a context branch where النفس is the opening of dawn, producing a breathing-horizon image. It remains anchored in the focus's lamps, two-day timing, and knowing estimation, while 41:37 and 41:53 supply day-night and horizon-self correspondences. Downstream prose should retain it as a temporal and phenomenological analogy, not a claim that the sky literally breathes.

activation_trace.role: Morning and first light let the lamps activate temporal opening as well as luminous objects.
A temporal duration supplies the measured rhythm within which openings recur.
Measured limit supplies regulation of the light-dark rhythm.
Night and its darkness supply the closure phase of the cycle.
Day opening through light supplies the expansion phase paired with morning.
The opening of dawn like a breath supplies the explicit bridge between self, breath, and first light.
Distant horizons locate the visible opening where the rhythm is perceived.

changed_reading.before: The lamps are fixed celestial lights within a measured construction.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they also mark a measured horizon rhythm in which darkness closes and daylight opens like breath.

strongest_changes: The seven heavens shift from static layers to differentiated units in an articulated cosmic communiqué.
Immediate creation context turns each heaven's affair into an operating charge within an obedient provisioning and preservation network.
The mighty protected book makes guarding readable as integrity protection for transmitted order, not only spatial defense.
Horizon signs and comprehensive witness make the lamps evidentiary marks paired with signs in selves.
The closing enclosure of every thing unites local guarding, complete knowledge, and total custody.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly couples the focus vocabulary with revelation, willing response, material testimony, protected transmission, measured emergence, and horizon evidence. Most diagnostic is the closing ح و ط inventory, whose preservation and knowledge branches directly recombine حِفْظًا and ٱلْعَلِيمِ.
remaining_uncertainties: أَمْرَهَا may denote each heaven's operative charge, its affair, or a decree; several models depend on the stronger functional reading.
The parallel between the guarded heaven and the inviolable book is mechanically coherent but may be analogical rather than an intended identity.
The legal-jurisdiction model depends on carrying the later adjudicative use of ق ض ي back into a focus form dominated by completion and making.
The marked-membrane, gestational, and breathing-dawn outliers depend on non-dominant or cross-domain branches and require explicit exploratory qualification.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Differentiated layers with internal operating directives.** **ق ض ي B005** supplies perfected making and execution, **و ح ي B001/B002** hidden imparting and indication, **ء م ر B002** directive, and **ق د ر B005/B006** deliberate arrangement and fitting proportion. “In each sky its command” distributes instruction within the completed plurality. I infer that differentiation includes local operation, not only spatial stacking. Each heaven reads as a formed domain carrying its assigned rule.
2. **Adornment that also guards.** **ز ي ن B002/B003** gives displayed beauty and adornment; **ص ب ح B005** gives lamp/source of light; **ح ف ظ B001** gives preservation and guarding. Adornment and protection share one clause. I infer that visibility can serve boundary maintenance rather than mere decoration. The nearest sky reads simultaneously as legible display and guarded interface.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:19 and 41:28 reuse the fire-root **ن و ر B002** for punishment, while 41:37 warns against worshipping luminous signs. Those later ayat prevent the lamps here from becoming autonomous sacred objects: their beauty remains assigned, functional, and guarded.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Completion by differentiated internal directives.** Lexically, `ق ض ي B005` is perfected making and execution, `و ح ي B004` divine imparting, `ء م ر B002` directive, and `ق د ر B005` orderly arrangement by deliberation. Structurally, each heaven receives `أمرها` after the undifferentiated smoke and joint answer of 41:11. I assign perfected making the role of completing distinct layers and revelation the role of installing a layer-specific operating directive. The inferred arrow is that differentiation is functional because each layer receives its own command. The ayah reads as distributed order under one measure, not mere numerical multiplication.

2. **One visible layer performs display and defense.** `س م و B004` is overhead sky/cover, `ز ي ن B002` makes beauty show, `ص ب ح B005` is lamp/light-source, and `ح ف ظ B001` is guarding. The coordination of lamps and `حفظًا` places ornament and protection in one clause. I assign the nearest overhead layer a dual role: perceptible display and guarded boundary. The abductive move is that the same configured features may communicate order while maintaining it. Beauty consequently reads as functional visibility rather than detachable decoration.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:16 unexpectedly sharpened the dual display/defense reading: the ordered sky that bears lamps and protection also contains forces that can descend as calibrated punishment. Protection is therefore an assigned function within power, not inert ornament.

findings.text: Yedi göğün tamamlanması yalnızca katmanlaşma değildir; her katmana kendi buyruğunun bildirilmesi, ortak ölçü altında yerel işleyişler kurar.
Yakın gökteki kandillerin güzelliği süsten ibaret kalmaz; görünürlük aynı zamanda sınırı koruyan işlevsel bir düzene katılır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: hidden transmission of knowledge `quranic:root_001633:B001/m01`; writing and engraving `quranic:root_001633:B003/m01`; divine inspiration and report `quranic:root_001633:B004/m01`; descending delivery of revelation `quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`; messenger and carried message `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; spoken utterance `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; glad-news proclamation `quranic:root_000120:B005/m01`; danger-warning that awakens caution `quranic:root_001488:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The channel begins with communication that is hidden, gestural, or engraved and ends with an audible human address. Descent and messenger-bearing form the transfer mechanism, while good news and warning are the two public effects of the same dispatched knowledge.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Creation is rendered as workshop practice, structural engineering, and ongoing maintenance rather than as undifferentiated origination.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Survey, Sizing, and Fabrication
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A maker measures before cutting, assigns form and condition, levels the result, and completes the work.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: measuring before cutting or acting `quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`; bringing a formed creation into existence `quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`; manufacturing or producing `quranic:root_000248:B001/m01`; assigning a thing to a condition `quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`; exact amount and limit `quranic:root_001205:B001/m01`; planning by calculation and fit `quranic:root_001205:B005/m01`; rectification after unevenness `quranic:root_000766:B002/m01`; completed and executed workmanship `quranic:root_001237:B005/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Creation begins as measurement, not random accumulation. Making, assigning, straightening, and finishing form one fabrication sequence in which every part reaches a fitted limit.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Foundation, Roof, Anchor, Lamp, and Guard
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A lower foundation is paired with an overhead roof, fixed by anchors, lit by lamps, and placed under guard.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: earth as the lower support opposite the sky `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`; sky as roof and whatever rises to shade `quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`; fixed and rooted mass `quranic:root_000564:B001/m01`; ship-like anchoring `quranic:root_000564:B002/m01`; lamp or sconce `quranic:root_000839:B005/m01`; guarding and maintenance `quranic:root_000342:B001/m01`; upper direction `quranic:root_001188:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Earth and sky become the floor and roof of a maintained habitation. The mountains carry an anchoring function, while the lamps and guard extend construction into illumination and upkeep.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Stored Provision in Managed Cycles
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Sustenance depends on contained reserves released in measured and recurring portions.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The allotted provisions of the earth open into two concrete systems: a rain-fed reservoir and the replenishing udder of a managed herd.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Reservoir and Rain-Fed Reserve
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water is held in a basin, replenished from cloud-borne pulses, and allotted to produce stable growth and food.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fixed water in a basin `quranic:root_000109:B003/m01`; stable and growing benefit `quranic:root_000109:B004/m01`; food that sustains the body `quranic:root_001268:B001/m01`; recurring cloud-water pulses `quranic:root_001188:B008/m01`; spring rain and pasture `quranic:root_000536:B005/m01`; measured allotment `quranic:root_001205:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Blessing takes the material form of a stable water reserve whose measured releases sustain pasture and food. The reservoir scene gives spatial and temporal mechanics to the provision allotted in the surface passage.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Undivided authority establishes the terms of relation and elicits either willing alignment or compelled compliance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The cosmic command reads simultaneously as polity, contract, and bodily readiness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Command Met Willingly or Under Compulsion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An obligation is issued, the addressee becomes ready to approach, and compliance is distinguished from coerced performance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: binding command `quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`; readiness and compliant access `quranic:root_000009:B003/m01`; obedience and yielding `quranic:root_000956:B001/m01`; mutual agreement and compliance `quranic:root_000956:B002/m01`; capacity to perform `quranic:root_000956:B003/m01`; aversion `quranic:root_001295:B001/m01`; coercion into an unwanted act `quranic:root_001295:B003/m01`; straight and balanced course `quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene distinguishes capacity, willingness, aversion, and force as separate relations to one command. Straightness is the stable outcome of alignment, while coercion names the opposed route by which the same demand can be met.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insanlar arasındaki uyuşmazlığı karara bağlama anlamıyla kesin bir buyruk verme anlamını aynı dalda açıkça destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki kesinlik, yalnızca kararın söylenmesini değil, konunun ayrılıp sonuçlandırılmasını da anlatır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bildirimde bulunmayı, bir işi bitirmeyi, borç ödemeyi veya ölümü değil; bağlayıcı bir yargı ya da kesin buyruk vermeyi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal, hükme bağlama ve kesin buyruk verme çekirdeğiyle tanımlanır; başka dallara özgü kalıp anlamları bu tanıma katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir uyuşmazlığı hükme bağlayıp taraflar için kesin bir karara varmak veya bir işi bağlayıcı bir buyrukla kesinleştirmektir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, çekirdeği karar verme ve işi kesin biçimde sonuca bağlama olarak ortaklaşa sunar; yargısal kullanımda bu, taraflar arasındaki ayrımı bağlayıcı bir hükümle belirler.

error_profile.loses: Yargı dışındaki kesin buyruk verme kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, belirli yönelme kalıplarında bir ahdi, vasiyeti veya talimatı iletmeyi ve bir bilgiyi kesin biçimde muhataba ulaştırmayı açıkça bir araya getirir. Geçici çerçeve bu iki yapıya bağlı anlamı doğru biçimde yansıtır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ölümün bir kişiye erişip yaşamını sona erdirmesini, kişinin ölmesini, birini öldürmeyi ve ölümü kaçınılmaz biçimde uygulanan son olarak adlandırmayı birlikte destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki ölüm ve öldürücü sonuç sınırı bu kanıtla uyumludur.

Ölümü, kaçınılmaz biçimde yürürlüğe giren son veya öldürücü güç olarak adlandırma.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, ölümün gerçekleşmesi ile birini öldürme kullanımlarını ortaklaşa verir ve ölümün geri çevrilemeyen, uygulanan bir son olarak adlandırılmasını bu çekirdeğe bağlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, sona erme bildiren biçim ile belirli iş, gereksinim, ibadet ve süre söz öbeklerini ayırır; bu kalıpların bütün ayrıntıları çıplak biçime yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi, gereksinimi, ibadeti veya süreyi son sınırına ulaştırıp tamamlamak; ya da bir şeyin süresi dolarak geçip gitmesi, tükenmesi ve ortadan kalkmasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir işi veya süreci gereken son sınıra ulaştırarak tamamlayıp bitirme.
Bir şeyin süresi veya varlığı sona ererek geçip gitmesi ve tükenmesi.
Bir işin artık geri alınamayacak biçimde kesin olarak sonuçlanması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir işi bitirip ondan çıkma ile bir şeyin süresinin veya varlığının tükenip gitmesini aynı sona ulaşma çevresinde birleştirir; bazı kullanımlarda sonuç geri alınamaz duruma gelir.

concept_gloss.text: tamamlayıp bitirmek veya sona erip tükenmek
concept_gloss.applicability: Etkenin bir işi bitirmesi ile bir şeyin kendiliğinden sona erip ortadan kalkması arasındaki ayrımı koruyarak dalın bütün çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Tamamlama, son sınıra ulaşma, tükenme ve ortadan kalkma yönlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gereksinim, ibadet, yükümlülük veya süre gibi bir işin sonuna ulaştırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Etkenin bir işi son sınırına ulaştırıp bitirmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir şeyin kendiliğinden tükenip ortadan kalkması yönünü dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin süresi veya varlığı biterek geçip gittiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sona erme, geçip gitme ve tükenme yönlerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir etkenin işi bilinçli olarak tamamlayıp bitirmesini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işin geri alınamayacak veya düzeltilemeyecek biçimde tamamlandığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sonucun kesinleşmesi ve geri alınamaz duruma gelmesi yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel tamamlama ile tükenip yok olma kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal eksiksiz ve tam duruma gelmeyi öne çıkarır; odak dal buna ek olarak işten çıkmayı, sürenin dolmasını ve varlığın tükenmesini içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir gereksinimi, ibadeti veya işi etken olarak tamamlayıp bitirmeyi içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yol, vadi ve kumluk gibi uzamsal şeylerin uç veya bitim noktasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyin devamının kesilerek son sınıra ulaşmasını karşılar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hem etkenli tamamlama hem tükenip gitme sürecidir; komşu dal daha genel kesilme, zamanın bitmesi ve uzamsal son nokta çevresindedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Canlılık şartı olmadan iş, süre, gereksinim veya nesnenin tamamlanmasını ve tükenmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yaşamın ölümle sona ermesini ve bir canlının öldürülmesini gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir sürecin artık sürmediği kesin bir son vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel tamamlanma ve tükenmedir; komşu dalın kurucu sonucu yalnızca yaşamın sona ermesidir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الفراغ من الحاجة والعبادة والمناسك، تمام الأمر، انقضاء الشيء وفناؤه، وقضاء الأجل والوطر والعبرة
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه القضاء القضائي، ولا الوصية إلى المخاطب، ولا الديون إلا من جهة أدائها

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi yapmak, biçimlendirmek ve kusursuzca tamamlamak ile tasarlanan eylemi kararlılıkla yürürlüğe koymayı ortak bir sonuçlandırma çekirdeğinde destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki yaratma ve yapma örnekleri, genel bir var etme anlamına genişletilmeden bu sınır içinde kullanılabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca yapma, kusursuzca tamamlama ve eylemi yürürlüğe koyma çekirdeğidir; salt planlama, ölçme veya sözlü karar verme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, yapıp kusursuzca tamamlama çekirdeğini belirli yaratma, iş görme ve sağlam ürün söz öbeklerinden ayırır; bu örneklerin özel kapsamı çıplak biçime taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi yapıp biçim vererek sağlam ve kusursuz duruma getirmek veya tasarlanan bir eylemi kararlılıkla gerçekleştirip yürürlüğe koymaktır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi yapma, biçimlendirme ve işi kusursuzca tamamlayarak sağlam duruma getirme.
Tasarlanan eylemi kararlılıkla gerçekleştirip amaçlanan sonuca kadar yürütme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir şeyi yapıp kusursuzca tamamlamayı ve istenen eylemi sonuca kadar yürütmeyi ortaklaştırır; yaratma örneği de ortaya çıkarma ile işi bitirme aşamalarını birlikte taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi, borçlunun borcu geri vererek ilişkiyi kapatmasını ve alacaklının hakkını istemesi ya da tahsil etmesini destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki zorunlu ödemede geçerli sayılan deve, yalnızca ayrı bir sözcük biriminin tanıklığıdır ve dal düzeyindeki kaynak ifadesinde bulunmadığı için çekirdek tanıma alınmamıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, borç veya hakkın ödeme, isteme ve tahsil yoluyla kapatılmasıyla sınırlıdır; yargısal karar ve genel bitirme anlamlarından ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, borç ödeme söz öbeği ile isteme ve tahsil biçimlerini ayrı katılımcı yönleri olarak korur; tek bir kalıbın kapsamı bütün çıplak biçimlere yayılmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yedi sayısını çekirdek alır; yedide bir payı, bir topluluğun yedincisi olmayı, yetmişi, yedi günlük ya da yedi aşamalı dönemleri ve yedi kez yapılan işlemleri bu çekirdeğe bağlar. Bazı kullanımlarda yedi, kesin sayımın ötesinde çoğaltma ve pekiştirme de bildirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnız sayı ve sayıya dayalı kullanımları kapsar; yırtıcı hayvan, kötüleme ve kalıplaşmış ağır zarar anlamları ayrı dallardadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın sayı ve kesir anlamlarını korurken hafta, yedi tur, yedi gece ve yedi kez yapma gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımları ayrı yüzler olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Yedi sayısını ve bu sayıya göre kurulan pay, sıra, dönem, çevrim ya da yineleme ilişkilerini anlatır. Bazı bağlı kullanımlarda tam yediyle sınırlı kalmadan çoğaltma ve pekiştirme işlevi kazanır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, altıdan sonra ve sekizden önce gelen yedi sayısı ile bir grubun yedincisi olma durumudur.
Bir bütünün yedi eşit parçasından biri ile altmıştan sonra gelen yetmişlik onluk da sayı çekirdeğine bağlıdır.
Yedi günlük hafta ve yedi aşamalı çevrimler, sayının zaman ya da hareket düzenine uygulanmasıdır.
Develerin belirli bir yedi temelli aralıkla suya götürülmesi, sayıya bağlı özel bir sulama düzenidir.
Yedi tur atma, yedi gecede okuma, yedi gece kalma, yedinci günde işlem yapma ve yedi kez yıkama yalnız kendi kalıplarında geçerlidir.
Yediyle türetilen kimi ifadeler, kesin bir sayım yerine kat kat artırma ya da çokluk bildirebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çerçevesi yedi sayısıdır; kesir, sıra, hafta, yetmiş, yedi aşamalı uygulamalar ve özel sulama düzeni bu sayıdan türetilir. Toplu kanıt ayrıca yedinin bazı bağlamlarda kesin sınır değil, çoğaltma ve pekiştirme aracı olabildiğini gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: yedi sayısı ve yediye dayalı pay, sıra, dönem, işlem ve çokluk anlatımları
